GOOD TO KNOW

Questions?
Find your answer.

What is CITI?

CITI is a city app for local information and services, including transport, news, maps, polls, requests and air raid alerts. Choose your community to see what is available there.

Are all features available in my city?

Available services depend on your community and its data sources. Some features are already live, while others are being tested or prepared for launch. Select your community in the app to see what is available.

How do I find my city?

Check the community directory on this site for cities that are working with CITI or preparing to launch. Download the app and look for your community to see its current services.

Is the app available on iPhone and Android?

Yes. Download CITI from the App Store or Google Play. Air raid alert Live Activities are available on compatible iOS devices.

When will utility payments and appointments be available?

These services are being prepared for launch, and parking is currently in testing. Timing and availability depend on the connections in each community. Follow CITI for updates.

What if my community is not connected yet?

If you represent a municipality or want to bring CITI to your city, visit our site for local government teams to learn how to get started and contact us. CITI for municipalities ↗
